format: Kotlin (Android Kotlin Fragment with Compose integration)
description: HomeFragment.kt defines the main home screen Fragment for an Android TV app. It sets up a focus-managed layout with a Top Navigation bar, hero banner carousel, 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels' horizontal rails, handles focus navigation, auto-scrolling in the hero carousel, and integrates Compose UI components for the navigation bar. It also manages loading states and data updates via ViewModel and repositories.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main Fragment class responsible for rendering the home screen with focus management, hero carousel, content rails, and navigation logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and repository.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs and returns the root view hierarchy, setting up UI components and focus navigation.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and observes ViewModel LiveData states.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes auto-scroll and re-requests focus for navigation bar.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses hero auto-scroll.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Binds LiveData to UI updates for loading, success, and error states.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates Continue Watching rail with data items and sets focus routing.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates TV Channels rail with data items.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds the Compose-based top navigation bar, initial focus, and key handling to show/hide rails.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Creates a hero banner carousel with auto-scrolling, focus handling, and peeking layout adjustments.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Scrolls the hero carousel to center a specific card with peeking.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses the hero auto-scroll temporarily for user interaction.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Begins auto-scrolling the hero carousel at intervals.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops auto-scrolling the hero carousel.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Builds the 'Seguí viendo' section with title, loading view, and horizontal cards.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Builds the 'Canales de TV' section with title, loading view, and horizontal cards.
